say:1:1013223001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're interested in information about the golems, right?

say:2:1013223002:1.text: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
say:2:1013223002:1.male: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
say:2:1013223002:1.female: Quick, quick, give me some praise!

choice_prompt:3:1013223002.text: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
choice_prompt:3:1013223002.male: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
choice_prompt:3:1013223002.female: Quick, quick, give me some praise!

say:4:1013223003:1.text: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.
say:4:1013223003:1.source_cn: 当然是因为我善解人意地为大家请来了这里对魔偶最有研究的...
say:4:1013223003:1.male: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.
say:4:1013223003:1.female: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.

say:6:1013223004:2.text: Um... actually, my name is Donn...

say:7:1013223005:1.source_cn: 啊啊，不好意思唐恩先生！

say:8:1013223006:2.text: No worries, I'm used to it. Golem research has always been a niche field... until the recent golem sightings got my attention, and that's when I joined the conservatory.
say:8:1013223006:2.source_cn: 没事，我习惯了。傀儡……不，魔偶研究，一直都是冷门领域...

say:9:1013223007:1.text: So, I'm really happy that you're interested in golems!
say:9:1013223007:1.source_cn: 所以，诸位能对魔偶感兴趣，我真的很开心！

say:11:1013223008:1.text: Wow, he's like a whole different person when talking about his work.

say:12:1013223009:1.text: In ancient times, golems were used by humans to combat Hypofiends. There are even legends that suggest the goddess Dura created these golems...
say:12:1013223009:1.source_cn: 魔偶……不，最初应该叫做傀儡，是上古时期人类对付魔物的...

say:14:1013223010:2.text: Dura above, this is the canon that's always been passed down in the Temple!
say:14:1013223010:2.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这是圣堂一直流传的正典！

say:16:1013223011:2.text: Blessed be Dura. However, what progress has been made in researching why they started to attack humans?
say:16:1013223011:2.source_cn: 感谢艾雅的恩泽。但艾雅创造的傀儡，为什么转而攻击人类，...

say:17:1013223012:1.text: Whether they were created by Dura or humans, they were supposed to stop operating after the war.
say:17:1013223012:1.source_cn: 不管出自艾雅还是上古人类之手，总之战争结束后，一应停止...

say:18:1013223013:1.text: But now they've been reactivated and turned into terrifying golems targeting humans.
say:18:1013223013:1.source_cn: 但现在，傀儡被重新启动，变成了针对人类的可怕魔偶。

say:19:1013223014:1.text: The energy required to give them movement probably isn't simple...
say:19:1013223014:1.source_cn: 能够再次赋予它们行动能力的能源，恐怕不会简单……

choice_prompt:20:1013223014.text: The energy required to give them movement probably isn't simple...
choice_prompt:20:1013223014.source_cn: 能够再次赋予它们行动能力的能源，恐怕不会简单……

say:21:1013223015:1.text: How did this energy fall into the hands of the Adamant Syndicate?
say:21:1013223015:1.source_cn: ……但这种能源，为什么会落到黑金商会手上？

say:22:1013223016:1.text: Can human power really produce such extraordinary things?
say:22:1013223016:1.source_cn: 人的力量……真的能生产出这种出格的东西吗？

say:25:1013223017:2.text: The energy you're talking about, is it those strange gemstones? Mr. Donn, I have an idea...
say:25:1013223017:2.source_cn: 你们说的能源，难道就是那种奇怪的宝石？唐恩先生，我有个...

say:26:1013223018:1.text: If we want to know more about strange gemstones from ancient artifacts...
say:26:1013223018:1.source_cn: 如果是研究古物里的奇怪宝石……

say:27:1013223019:1.text: Could there be people who know more information in the camp at the ruins?
say:27:1013223019:1.source_cn: 遗址那边的营地里，会不会有人了解更多信息？

say:28:1013223020:1.text: That's right. If you want to investigate the golem's energy source, the scholars in that camp might provide some clues.
say:28:1013223020:1.source_cn: 没错，我刚刚想提醒诸位。如果想调查魔偶的能源，那么那片...

say:29:1013223021:2.text: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?
say:29:1013223021:2.source_cn: 刚好，我也要去那片营地！老师，不如我们同时出发，比一比...
say:29:1013223021:2.male: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?
say:29:1013223021:2.female: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?

say:30:1013223022:2.text: Wait, Fay... Don't act so impulsively all the time. If you cause trouble again, our hearts won't be able to handle it!
say:30:1013223022:2.source_cn: 等一下，菲……短时间内，你还是不要独自行动了。你要是再...

say:31:1013223023:2.text: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?
say:31:1013223023:2.source_cn: 月神遗殿考古正在最关键的阶段，可不能因为这个影响研究！...

say:33:1013223024:2.male: I'd love to come with you! Please, take me along!!
say:33:1013223024:2.female: I'd love to come with you! Please, take me along!!
